title: Should we eat less rice?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why might reducing rice consumption be suggested in some environmental discussions?
How difficult is it to change a staple food that is deeply connected to culture and daily habits?
Would people accept eating less rice if alternatives were more expensive?
Should farmers receive support to adopt methods that reduce the environmental impact of rice production?
What food in your culture would be hardest to reduce even for environmental reasons?
